# `GenerationFailed`

`Rasuvaeff\PropertyTesting\Runner\GenerationFailed`

**Class** — **Package:** [property-testing-core](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core/blob/master/src/Runner/GenerationFailed.php#L15) — **Version:** working tree

**Implements:** [`Runner\PropertyResult`](/api/classes/Runner/PropertyResult)

A generator could not produce a valid value (e.g. a filter whose predicate
rejected every draw) — a clean failure instead of an uncaught crash.
